name: Degradatsiya 2: Prodolzheniye Nachala
source:
Stinky summer, thugs, voting, deception - isn't it wonderful for Sovfuck? In this story, our protagonists wake up in a familiar place, and they are immediately led to a crucial event: the election for the new head of Sovfuck!

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2293168208]Steam[/url]]
translation:
臭夏天、暴徒、投票、欺骗——这对Sovfuck来说不是很棒吗？在这个故事中，我们的主角在一个熟悉的地方醒来，他们立即被引导到一个关键事件：Sovfuck新任首领的选举！

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2293168208]Steam[/url]]
